Rather than blazing trails in art, science and literature, the friends are each variously burdened with disappointing relationships, children, aging parents and unemployment. showtimewomen.us.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
showtimewomen.us.description: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: Life During Wartime
showtimewomen.us.description: Nothing comes easily for Joy (Shirley Henderson) and her sisters, Trish (Allison Janney) and Helen (Ally Sheedy). Joy, unhappy with her job and her sleazy husband (Michael Kenneth Williams), is haunted by her dead boyfriend's ghost (Paul Reubens). Trish's pedophile husband (Ciarán Hinds) is behind bars, and she's ready to move on with her life. As an increasingly bitter Helen approaches middle age with a failing screenwriting career, it becomes clear her mother offers little comfort. (Comedy drama) - 2009

showtimewomen.us.title: Hard Truths
showtimewomen.us.description: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences. (Comedy drama) - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: Confess, Fletch
showtimenext.us.description: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend. (Comedy, Mystery) - 2022

showtimenext.us.title: Rebel in the Rye
showtimenext.us.description: Author J.D. Salinger leads a reclusive lifestyle after the success of his popular and controversial novel The Catcher in the Rye. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2017

showtimenext.us.title: The Woman in Black
showtimenext.us.description: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy) - 2012

screenpixvoices.us.title: Black Girl
screenpixvoices.us.description: The 17-year-old dreamer Billie Jean is the youngest in a family of loving yet discouraging women. Billie Jean's mother, Mama Rosie, cares deeply about her three biological children. However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs. (Drama) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
screenpixvoices.us.description: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life. (Drama) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Kitchen Toto
screenpixvoices.us.description: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them. (Drama) - 1987

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Mercenary
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Sergei Kowalski, a mercenary only out for himself and a few dollars, joins up with a Mexican peasant-turned-revolutionary, Paco Roman, when the price is right. No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly, a vengeful killer out for blood. (Western) - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault. (Western) - 1974

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Escort West
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the wake of the Civil War, ex-Confederate soldier Ben Lassiter and his 10-year-old daughter, Abbey, are traveling through Nevada when they cross paths with sisters Martha and Beth Drury. Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection. (Western) - 1959

showtime.us.title: Rush Hour 3
showtime.us.description: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Martial arts, Movie) - 2007-07-13

showtime.us.title: Total Recall
showtime.us.description: Douglas Quaid is a bored construction worker in the year 2084 who dreams of visiting colonized Mars. He visits "Rekall," a company that plants false memories into people's brains, in order to experience the thrill of Mars without having to travel there. But something goes wrong during the procedure; Quaid discovers that his entire life is actually a false memory and that the people who implanted it in his head now want him dead. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1990

showtime.us.title: Hostage
showtime.us.description: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family. (Action, Crime, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-03-11

showtime2west.us.title: Forrest Gump

showtime2west.us.title: Frida
showtime2west.us.description: Mexican painter Frida Kahlo (Salma Hayek) marries fellow artist Diego Rivera who shares her radical political views.

showtimefamily.us.title: Sabrina

showtimefamily.us.title: Queen Bees
showtimefamily.us.description: While her house undergoes repairs, fiercely independent senior Helen temporarily moves into a nearby retirement community, where she encounters lusty widows, cutthroat bridge tournaments and a hotbed of bullying "mean girls."

skyscifi.uk.title: Most Haunted - Coalhouse Fort Night 2
skyscifi.uk.description: Medium Johnnie Firori looks for spooks at Coalhouse Fort in Essex, a site believed to be a hotbed of paranormal activity such as mists, orbs and sudden drops in room temperature. (Documentary, Paranormal, Reality) - 2008

skyscifi.uk.title: Most Haunted - Morecambe Winter Gardens
skyscifi.uk.description: The team spend the night at Morecambe Gardens, where many ghosts are said to reside. The ghosts are supposedly split into the two halves of the garden, with `good' spirits haunting one side and `evil' spirits haunting the other. The team spend the first night on the good side, but is there such a thing as a `good' ghost. (Documentary, Paranormal, Reality) - 2008

His journey takes him to Victorian London where the Pirate Captain must choose between winning Pirate of the Year, or helping his crew. - 2012

skyselect.uk.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs (2009)
skyselect.uk.description: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky. (Comedy / Fantasy / Animated / Children) - 2009

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Comeback Trail
shoxbetwest.us.description: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. (Comedy) - 2020

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Heart Specialist
shoxbetwest.us.description: After following a former girlfriend to Florida, Ray Howard (Brian J. White) winds up as an intern in a not-so-prestigious teaching hospital. An unapologetic Lothario, Ray tries to work his charms on nurse Donna (Zoe Saldana), but she's already involved with the chief resident, Dr. Sidney Zachary (Wood Harris), who is also Ray's instructor. Sidney, who moonlights as a standup comic, decides that Ray needs to learn about true love, as well as medicine. (Romantic comedy) - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
shoxbetwest.us.description: Michael and Madison Roland planned to spend the rest of their lives together, but Michael's controlling ways turn their perfect marriage into an abusive roller-coaster ride that no woman could survive. With the help of her best friend, Madison decides to get away. After adopting a new identity, she meets Alex Stone and learns to love again. All seems well until Michael discovers Madison's whereabouts and re-creates her nightmare. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Sound of Violence
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. (Horror, Thriller) - 2021

showtimeshowcase.us.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
showtimeshowcase.us.description: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1996

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Sweet Virginia
showtimeshowcase.us.description: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: The November Man
showtimeextreme.us.description: Five years into his retirement, CIA veteran Peter Devereaux (Pierce Brosnan) is pulled back into service to help retrieve a Russian agent -- also his former lover -- who has incriminating evidence on Federov, a corrupt Russian leader. When a different CIA team, led by Devereaux's former protégé (Luke Bracey), shows up, the mission goes south and Devereaux's ex-lover is killed. Now a rogue agent, Devereaux drags a relief worker (Olga Kurylenko) along on his mission to settle the score. (Action, Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Adventure) - 2014

showtimeextreme.us.title: Basic Instinct
showtimeextreme.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

showtimeextreme.us.title: Changing Lanes
showtimeextreme.us.description: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost. (Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 2002
